description: Jones-Markov block weights y_λ at H_n(q₀) for n = 2..12, CONVENTION D (z_D = q^3/(q^2+1), the unique non-trivial Markov trace on H_3 whose radical contains the three-strand antisymmetriser). Closed form y_λ = [n-2k+1]_q/[2]_q^n on two-row shapes, exactly 0 at depth >= 2. Replaces the convention-C linear solve whose producer is in _deprecated/.
